semiconductor_relevance: High — Guangdong Tianyu Semiconductor specializes in silicon carbide epitaxial wafers, which are critical for power devices in various applications.
summary: Guangdong Tianyu Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of silicon carbide epitaxial wafers, recognized for its advanced manufacturing capabilities and automotive quality certification. The company produces both N-type and P-type doped semiconductor materials, catering to the growing demand in sectors such as new energy vehicles and industrial power supplies.
capabilities: Manufacturing of silicon carbide epitaxial wafers
Production of unipolar and bipolar power devices (650V~20000V)
Advanced epitaxial processes for semiconductor materials

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and is a pioneer in the industrialization of silicon carbide semiconductor materials within the country.
